# Regression test for BOLERO_PATH validation in BOLERO_PATH mode.
env BOLERO_MODULE=off

env ORIG_GOPATH=$BOLERO_PATH

# The literal path '.' in BOLERO_PATH should be rejected.
env BOLERO_PATH=.
! bolero build go-cmd-test/helloworld.go
stderr 'BOLERO_PATH entry is relative'

# It should still be rejected if the requested package can be
# found using another entry.
env BOLERO_PATH=${:}$ORIG_GOPATH${:}.
! bolero build go-cmd-test
stderr 'BOLERO_PATH entry is relative'

# BOLERO_PATH cannot be a relative subdirectory of the working directory.
env ORIG_GOPATH
stdout 'ORIG_GOPATH='$WORK[/\\]gopath
cd $WORK
env BOLERO_PATH=gopath
! bolero build gopath/src/go-cmd-test/helloworld.go
stderr 'BOLERO_PATH entry is relative'

# Blank paths in BOLERO_PATH should be rejected as relative (issue 21928).
env BOLERO_PATH=' '${:}$ORIG_GOPATH
! bolero build go-cmd-test
stderr 'BOLERO_PATH entry is relative'

[short] stop

# Empty paths in BOLERO_PATH should be ignored (issue 21928).
env BOLERO_PATH=${:}$ORIG_GOPATH
env BOLERO_PATH
bolero install go-cmd-test
exists $ORIG_GOPATH/bin/go-cmd-test$GOEXE

-- go-cmd-test/helloworld.go --
package main

func main() {
	println("hello world")
}
